flaps._comment: A380 has five lever positions: 0, 1, 2, 3, FULL. Config 1+F extends automatically from Config 1 at low speed; there is no dedicated lever notch. Speed values are based on public FlyByWire material and remain pending in-sim verification.

grades._comment: Provisional A380 landing-rate bands pending aircraft-specific source verification.

lvars._comment: A32NX_AUTOPILOT_1_ACTIVE, A32NX_AUTOTHRUST_STATUS, A32NX_FLAPS_HANDLE_INDEX, A32NX_PARK_BRAKE_LEVER_POS, A32NX_SPOILERS_ARMED, A32NX_SPOILERS_HANDLE_POSITION, and the FCU selected-value LVARs below are documented for the A380X in the FlyByWire A380X Flight Deck API. The A32NX_ prefix is expected on this aircraft.
lvars._commentFlaps: A32NX_FLAPS_HANDLE_INDEX is documented for A380X as a read-only custom LVAR with 0=UP and 4=FULL. Flight Fabric uses profile flap LVARs before SimConnect flap mapping.

spoilers._comment: The cited FlyByWire interface supplies the intended armed state through A32NX_SPOILERS_ARMED and a 0-1 handle fraction through A32NX_SPOILERS_HANDLE_POSITION; the standard SimConnect armed field is not used for this profile.

lvars._commentParkingBrake: The cited FlyByWire interface supplies the intended parking-brake lever state through A32NX_PARK_BRAKE_LEVER_POS (0=released, 1=set); the standard SimConnect field is not used for this profile.

mcp._comment: A380X documents selected speed, heading, and V/S as custom FCU LVAR readbacks. Selected altitude is documented as AUTOPILOT ALTITUDE LOCK VAR:3, so Flight Fabric keeps altitude on the existing SimConnect target path.
mcp.heading: A32NX_AUTOPILOT_HEADING_SELECTED

controls._comment: The exact-profile trusted adapter exposes a compact set of 34 guarded actions: three bounded FCU targets, a direct AP1 toggle plus guarded A/THR/LOC/APPR intents, seven exterior-light output targets, gear, relative flaps, parking brake, spoiler arm, and a bounded spoiler handle target. Every action requires fresh logical readback, at most one dispatch, no retry, and a newer matching or changed readback. AP2 remains read-only. V/S-FPA writes, managed/selected push-pull, light AUTO/detents, engines/APU, presets, and deep systems remain excluded.

meta.notes: Dedicated exact-profile FlyByWire A380X page with 42 logical fields and 34 guarded, untested actions. The compact write surface prioritizes FCU/autopilot and exterior lights, then gear, flaps, parking brake, and spoilers. Direct AP1 OFF/ON intents use the documented A32NX.FCU_AP_1_PUSH toggle behind fresh AP1 readback; AP2 and V/S-FPA remain read-only. Selected altitude uses the documented AUTOPILOT ALTITUDE LOCK VAR:3 confirmation path.

knownIssues: Gear limits are estimated pending a reviewable vendor or manufacturer source.
Flap handle value mapping (0-4 lever indices) not confirmed in MSFS
The profile relies on the FLAPS HANDLE INDEX path; its five detent positions still need in-sim verification.
All 34 write actions remain untested in the live aircraft. A documented standard simulator event can still be ignored or incompletely mirrored by a complex aircraft.
A32NX.FCU_AP_1_PUSH is a direct AP1 toggle. OFF/ON intents require fresh A32NX_AUTOPILOT_1_ACTIVE readback before dispatch and a newer matching result afterward; AP2 remains read-only.
Exterior-light readback confirms lamp output, not Airbus AUTO or selector-detent position. Only explicit OFF and ON output targets are exposed.
V/S-FPA writes, managed/selected push-pull, runway-turnoff writes, engines, APU, presets, guarded/emergency controls, and deep systems remain excluded.
